# Readflow — Full LLM API Reference

Readflow is a web-based markdown editor and publishing platform. Use this API to programmatically create shareable read-only markdown documents. No authentication or API key required for basic sharing.

## npm Package

Install the CLI and SDK:

```bash
npm i readflow-md
```

### CLI Usage

```bash
# Share a file
npx readflow-md share README.md

# Share with a title
npx readflow-md share --title "Setup Guide" ./docs/setup.md

# Share with an API key (links to your dashboard)
npx readflow-md config --token YOUR_API_KEY
npx readflow-md share README.md
```

### Programmatic Usage (Node.js)

```javascript
const readflow = require('readflow-md');

const { url } = await readflow.share({
  content: '# Hello World',
  title: 'My Document'
});
console.log(url); // https://readflow.aranish.uk/s/...
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/readflow-md

## Endpoints

### Create/Share a Document

POST https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share

Request (JSON):
| Field     | Type   | Required | Description                              |
|-----------|--------|----------|------------------------------------------|
| content   | string | Yes      | Raw markdown content                     |
| title     | string | No       | Document title (max 100 chars)           |
| password  | string | No       | Password-protect the shared link         |
| expiresIn | number | No       | Auto-expire in seconds (60–2592000)      |

Response (200 JSON):
| Field | Type   | Description                              |
|-------|--------|------------------------------------------|
| id    | string | Unique document ID                       |
| url   | string | Shareable URL: https://readflow.aranish.uk/s/{id} |

### Authenticated Sharing (with API key)

To have documents appear in your Readflow dashboard, include your API key:

POST https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

Documents created with a valid API key will be linked to your account and manageable from your dashboard.

### Upsert by Slug

To update an existing document by slug (requires API key):

POST https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

Request (JSON):
| Field      | Type   | Required | Description                    |
|------------|--------|----------|--------------------------------|
| content    | string | Yes      | Markdown content               |
| title      | string | No       | Title                          |
| upsertSlug | string | No       | Slug to upsert — updates if exists, creates if not |

## Rate Limits

- 25 shares per hour per IP address
- No authentication required for basic use
- API keys available from dashboard settings for ownership linking

## Errors

| Status | Meaning                    |
|--------|----------------------------|
| 400    | Missing or invalid content |
| 429    | Rate limited (25/hour/IP)  |
| 500    | Server error               |

## Examples

### curl — basic share
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"content": "# Hello World\n\nThis is a test.", "title": "Hello World"}' \
  | jq -r '.url'
```

### curl — share a local file
```bash
jq -Rs '{content: ., title: "My README"}' README.md \
  | curl -s -X POST https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @- \
  | jq -r '.url'
```

### curl — authenticated share
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rf_your_api_key_here" \
  -d '{"content": "# Agent Output\n\nGenerated by AI.", "title": "Agent Doc"}'
```

### Python
```python
import requests

resp = requests.post("https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share", json={
    "content": markdown_string,
    "title": "My Document"
})
print(resp.json()["url"])
```

### Node.js / fetch
```typescript
const resp = await fetch("https://readflow.aranish.uk/api/share", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ content: markdownString, title: "My Doc" }),
});
const { url } = await resp.json();
```

## What the shared page provides

- Rendered markdown with syntax highlighting, math (KaTeX), and Mermaid diagrams
- Download as .md or PDF
- Rich Open Graph previews for Discord, Slack, Twitter
- Mobile-responsive read-only view
- Optional password protection and expiry
